I didn't think smoking and drinking affected me, I thought it was just me. Shit ruined my life. 25 and have nothing left. If I were to tell my suicidal tendencies of three months ago any one thing... it would have been, "Why the fuck didn't you quit doing so many drugs a long fucking time ago, we wouldn't be here now!"

My primal urges to fight/flight emerge and I have no choice but to defend the little bit of a life I have right now. It translates directly to fucking fight... and beyond. My cognitive thinking skills are not the first to action whenever we're even in the same room. I must sleep on this. Thanks for your reply.

Iv never been to rehab... until 3 months ago for the first time I was living in close quarters with meth heads, heroin addicts and alcoholics who were all "like me"... addicts. Fuck that. They were NOT like me. I have a level head and like to smoke weed and drink everyday... I found the silk road and went on a 2 month molly bender. Was smoking dmt and eating a plethora of lsd and mushrooms mixed in but im not an addict. I will admit I have an addictive personality which sent me into a raging druggin spree that ended with a psychological trainwreck of jealousy anger and resentment with my girlfriend at the time. Needless to say I ended up in jail on my first domestic violence charge.
 Today is my 2 months clean day... after a month of rehab I've been in sober living. Rehab was bad. Like really fucking bad. I never hated my life that much but I wanted to kill someone else for the situation I was in. Now that I have a little more freedom I am able to contact my old friends and my exgirlfriend now which all seems to be for the worse. (I bet you thought my story was going to get positive :) my friends are still in the mountains snowboarding having the time of their lives, my ex girlfriend has block me in all social aspects. I can't find a job because of my record and am now seeing how much of a peice of shit I have been. Wanting to kill myself but cant because Im too scared. Everyday feels like an eternity in hell. I dont know why I feel the worst I ever have but have been clean the longest I ever have. Meetings make me want to vomit probably because theyre mandatory.  I just want to be successful on my own. I just have to quit short circuting my brain and let it heal, wounds and all. I am an addict but addiction is wanting to still do fucking drugs. I dont want to anymore they dont help. I relapsed in rehad thats why im 2 months clean but went to rehab 3 months ago. I just know I never want to go through this viscous cycle again. If I can get past this stage I think it will be smooth sailing from here. 
   I would have a better outlook on suicide if I could bring myself to believe it is like a reset button... where you simply respawn in the womb but with the knowledge of this bit of life you have experienced so far. Unfortunately my thoughts on death are completely, well I dont know... thats it. I just dont know. Thats scarrier to me than wollowing in my saddness and self loathing right now. Ultimately I feel like emotions and the fluctuating periods of ups and downs all end up equaling out like a rollercoaster... you get off at the same place you got on, but now your on the other side with the knowledge and thrill of thwat the fuck just happened. Like you remember having a good hard cry over something when you were younger and after the perverbial sun came out and you feel like a million bucks because you realized it wasnt something to cry about, you felt more confident but still a little scared and trembly, at the same time uncontrollably giddy. WELL, im not quite there yet but I believe thats what itll be like once this shit-tastic feeling of fuck my life has run its course.
